Email template — Customer Statement

Customer statement email templates allow you to customize the emails sent when delivering customer statements to your customers.

This template will be used whenever you email a customer statement from the Customer Statements report.

Template Configuration

You can customize both the subject line and message body of the email. The template supports placeholders that will be automatically replaced with actual values when sending the email.

Common placeholders include customer name, statement date, and business details. These placeholders ensure each email is personalized with the correct information.

Subject

Default email subject line when emailing customer statements.

Message body

Default email body text when emailing customer statements. You can include merge fields to personalize the message.
